batting.dismissal: c BB McCullum b AB Agarkar

batting.dismissal: c AB Dinda b M Kartik

batting.dismissal: c BB McCullum b CH Gayle

batting.name: AM Rahane
batting.dismissal: c CH Gayle b I Sharma

batting.name: BB McCullum
batting.dismissal: c SL Malinga b AM Nayar

balls.text: Duminy take a bow! Dinda fires it full on the off side and Duminy reaches out and places it straight over the bowler's head, all brute force, what's more, it's his fifty as well!
shuffles and inside edges to square leg
makes room and crashes him through the off side and McCullum sets a shining example to slide and cut it off
fetch that! It was almost on a yorker length and Duminy gets under neath the bounce and carts him several rows over wide long-on
he makes room and crashes a low full toss to mid-off and the fielder does well to slide and intercept it
swipes a low full toss to square leg, Dinda does well to keep it full
fires a quick yorker outside off and Duminy digs it out and gets an inside edge wide of the stumps
Rahane gets too cheeky and pays the price, he goes a log way across his stumps to paddle it over short fine leg but the big man Gayle's there to lap it up
backs away and he fires it on the pads and he swings to the on side
pushes a low full toss down the track and Ishant gets a finger to it and deflects it off
makes room, swings and misses and they collect a bye as the keeper fumbles

he's caught off a waist high no-ball and Ishant is ticked! Rahane scoops it towards short mid-off, Ishant takes it and hears the dreaded call from the umpire and flings the ball on the turf in frustration
he steps down the pitch and adjusts his stroke on seeing a slow full toss and instead steers it wide of point, the timing was so good that the sweeper had no chance
nice inswinging yorker and Rahane gets a thick inside edge onto his pads and the ball rolls past the stumps, they steal a single
full on the offstump and he squeezes it to cover
JP's slamming them! Shukla drops it short again and Duminy makes a wee bit of room and whacks it over deep midwicket this time, people there better take cover
drops it full on the stumps and he makes room and swings it to midwicket
he clips a low full toss to deep midwicket
Shukla drops it short and the bounce sits up nicely for Duminy as he swivels and blasts it down to the grass embankment at deep square leg, wake up call for the fans there
he experiments with a reverse sweep and finds short third man
turns it to short midwicket and sets off
walks down and steers it off his pads to the off side
chips down the track and Duminy takes the aerial route and places it just wide of McCullum at midwicket and the ball beats long-on as well, talk about placement!
chips down the track and pushes him down to wide long-off
goes on the backfoot and pushes it to deep square leg
makes room and cuts wide of point
Gayle varies his pace and dishes out the quicker one, he drops it short and Napier's eyes light up as he tries to whack it but he gets a tame top edge to mid-on
he fires it full on the stumps and he whips it across the line and bisects the gap at deep square leg, the fielder dives and parries it away to the boundary
strays down the leg side and the keeper fails to get around and cut it off
driven with the spin to long-on
Gayle pushes Duminy away as he fields off his own bowling, no wrong intentions
kneels down early and slogs him down to long-on
angles it on the pads and he clips it down to deep square leg
drops it on a good length and he punches it wide of mid-off
angles it from outside leg and he opens the face of the bat and steers him to third man
waits for it, opens the face of the bat and glides it down to third man
keeps it full on the offstump and he pushes it down to long-on
appeal for an lbw! Duminy gets a thick inside edge onto his pads
full outside off and he drives to deep extra cover
McCullum drops a sitter! Napier clubs a friendly full toss to midwicket and McCullum fluffs it
tosses it on the pads and he works it wide of deep midwicket
low full toss and he pushes it hard down to long-off
rocks back and punches him  down to long-off
works it to deep square-leg for a single
slower through the air and he tries to whip it away to the on side but plays too early
skids off the pitch and he fails to make contact as he tries to cut
quicker through the air and he forces it down the pitch
drops it short and he rocks back and slams it down to sweeper cover
clips it back to the bowler
shuffles and clips it to the on side
straighter one and he works it to midwicket
juicy half volley first up and he works it to sweeper cover
Nayar gives him the charge again trying to clear the on side but he gets a thick under edge off a low full toss and loses his leg stump
glances it down to fine leg
works it forcefully to long-on and Duminy slips as he turns around for the second run
comes down the track and whams it in the air past the bowler and nearly cleans up the umpire,  heads up everyone
angles it on the pads and he clips it off his pads
this one comes back in and skids through, he makes room and slices it wide of point
makes room and cuts straight to point
tries to work it across the line but the ball clips his pads and rolls away
chips down the track and biffs a full toss to long-off
turns the face of the bat and clips it softly to short midwicket and sets off
rocks back and punches and sweeper cover intercepts it with his palm, they steal a single
punches him down to long-off again
gets well forward and drives to long-off
swept to deep midwicket
tucked to short midwicket
close shout for lbw! He gets forward and the ball hits the bottom the pad and maybe in line with the stumps, Erasmus shakes his head, replays suggested that it may have clipped legstump
slow through the air and he hits if against the turn to square leg
skids through and the ball rolls off the bottom edge to short third man
goes back and punches it to the off side
punched hard to short cover and Mccullum effects an athletic save to his right
slow through the air and it induces a leading edge to point
taps it in front of cover, sets off but heads back
lands outside off and he lets it go
Tendulkar perishes to a low full toss! The ball swings away from him and he reaches out and punches it off the toe of the bat and McCullum falls forward at short cover and takes the catch
the slow bouncer this time and he slides down the leg side
shot! Agarkar drops it too full outside off and tendulkar gets on his knee and smashes it along the turf to deep extra cover, the sweeper had no chance
Agarkar drops it on a good length and Tendulkar gives the charge and tonks him high over long-off, that's authority for you
Tendulkar tries to upper cut it as Agarkar drops it short, late choice of shot and he fails to make contact
angles it into the left hander and he works it wide of midwicket
commits early to the front foot and punches it straight to sweeper cover
appeal! Tendulkar tries to sweep a full toss and he may have been struck just outside the line of offstump, Shukla runs across and cuts it off
short outside off and he pulls but finds midwicket
Shukla teases him with width outside off and Tendulkar falls for the bait and flashes hard again and misses
knocks it back to the bowler
short and wide outside off and he flashes hard and misses
gets beside the line and steers it to the off side
flighted on middle and leg, he chips down the pitch to tonk him over the on side but he doesn't get enough elevation and Dinda takes it easily at deep midwicket
forces it to mid-on
he has a free swing and the top edge lands in the middle of nowhere at long leg
shuffles and works it to the on side

looked like a mis-hit at first but that carried over the rope alright, he reaches forward to a flighted delivery, didn't look  like he got to the pitch of it but there was enough elevation to clear long-off
full in length outside off and he pushes it through the line to mid-off
Appeal, he drops it in front of short cover and sets off, Harbhajan sends him back and there's a direct hit, the third umpire has a look and Tendulkar is safe
Shukla errs by sliding it on the pads and with fine leg up the batsman just needs to trickle it away and that's what Tendulkar did
he gets a low full toss and he works it forcefully do to deep square leg, there's protection there
flashes hard and gets a thickish edge down to third man
punches it on the front foot off the middle of the bat and just beats short cover, mid-off picks it up
fullish outside off and pushed down the ground to mid-off
angles it on the body and he clips it too early, the ball rolls to the on side
the ball is short and Harbhajan picks it from outside off and plays the chopper shot which Dhoni often plays
it sat up there to whack down the ground but he mistimed the swat to mid-off
shuffles across his stumps to glance him down to fine leg but the ball is wide

loose shot selection by Jayasuriya, he exposes his stumps and charges down the pitch, Dinda drops it a bit short and induces a thick edge as Jayasuriya tries to clam it through the off side, van Wyk makes no mistake, very easy take
tucks him up by getting the ball to nip back in off the pitch, the ball clips his pads and rolls away
slower ball on the pads and he flicks it hard down to square leg
pushes it down the pitch to mid-off
136 kph, Jayasuriya gets a very quick bouncer and the ball nearly brushes his glove as he tries to hook, van Wyk leaps up and fumbles, tough one for the keeper
Tendulkar reaches out and gets a thick outside edge to third man, Dinda does superbly to slide and cut it off
nips it back into the right hander and Tendulkar steers it towards short cover and tells his partner to stay back
fullish in length outside off, he gets forward and pushes it to mid-off
he nurdles it just wide of short fine leg and there's hesitation for the second run, Tendulkar's halfway down the pitch before he sprints back
he's hitting them off the middle of the bat but invariably he finds the fielder, mid-off picks it up
keeps it on a good length outside off and he punches it down to backward point
chops it down towards cover, the offside field is packed
much better, holds the length back and Jayasuriya opts to shoulder arms
Dinda errs by pitching it up outside off and Jayasuriya launches into it and lofts through the line high over mid-off
streaky boundary and Ishant nearly gets him there, he reaches out to a wide delivery and gets a thick inside edge which beats the stumps and keeper
nice punched drive but he finds Shukla at backward point
Tendulkar has a wild swish outside off and luckily for him it's a wide, not far from the edge
a misfield gets Tendulkar off the mark, he punches him hard past cover and Shukla sprints and pulls it back
hits the right length outside off and Tendulkar tries to force it past the covers
wide outside the offstump and Tendyulka sticks his pad out and watches it through
pushes it with soft hands down the pitch and mid-off runs across and has a shy at the stumps and Jayasuriya is home
starts off with  wide down the leg side and Jayasuriya has a feel for it
Kolkata limp to yet another defeat, Saha swings him to long-on and that's just a single
fullish on the legstump and he swings him along the turf to long-on
takes a few paces down the pitch and clubs a full toss over midwicket, just a few inches short of the rope
McCullum makes room and he fails to send a low full toss over the rope, Malinga is there at deep extra cover
sprays it wide outside off and he chases it and takes a single to long-off
he makes room and scoops him high over the off side, the ball drops short of third man

forces it towards Duminy at long-on and they turn around for the second, Hodge was running across rather than straight and that hampered his chances of making his ground, Pinal Shah flicks the ball onto the stumps and the decision goes upstairs
Hodge was out of his crease at the start and Malinga purposely drops it short and bowls a bouncer, Hodge looks at the umpire Erasmus but he gives the benefit of the doubt to the bowler
yorker on the legstumps and he shuffles and squeezes it out to the on side
brilliant stuff frpm malinga! The batsman makes room and he just manages to dig it out in front of the stumps
full outside off and he makes room and jams it to long-off
it's a fast yorker and he turns the face of the bat and steers it to point
another yorker and he digs it out to the off side
full outside off and he drives uppishly towards long-off
Zaheer errs by dropping it on a good length and Hodge makes room and scoops it over backward point's reach
gets on  the backfoot and he takes a quick single to cover
see that stump cartwheel! Shukla makes room to a fast and fiery full toss and misses it completely, the offstump tumbles backwards and lands at the halfway point between the crease and the keeper
fires the yorker and he chops it almost one handed to short cover
makes room and he scoops a length ball over backward point, the ball swirls in the air and drops short of the boundary
yorker outside off and he swings hard and mistmes it to the off side
Malinga strays wide outside off and the batsman makes a bit of room and misses
exposes his stumps and swings hard at another yorker and he gets a thick inside edge to the on side
makes room and Shukla squirts a yorker straight to midwicket
an unplayable yorker and he swings hard and the ball rolls down the pitch
bowls a screeching yorker and the batsman trudges back at the crease and just manages to get bat on ball to clip it to deep square
slammed hard down the ground and the ball scorches towards the boundary but Napier does splendidly to sprint from long-off, slide and relay the ball to long-on, that was barely inches from the rope
yorker outside off and he pushes it to the off side
full on the pads and worked forcefully to long-on
Free Hit That will hurt Mumbai! He stays at the crease and swats a length ball just over Napier's reach at long-off, good attempt though
he oversteps and Hodge digs out a yorker to the keeper
searches for swing and it's another full toss but he plays off the bottom half of the bat and mistimes it to the off side
low full toss outside off and he slams it hard down to long-off
short outside off and slammed straight to third man

Napier bowls a low full toss on middle and leg and van Wyk gets on his knee and tries to club him straight but he doesn't get the required elevation and Duminy takes a fine catch running forward from long-on
lands it outside off and he slams it to sweeper cover
full on middle and leg and hammered back to Napier
and that's the first fifty by a Kolkata batsman! Napier swings it in late and it lands on a yorker length, he reaches out and squirts it past the keeper
that was raw power! Hodge clears his front foot to a full delivery and sends it screeching down the pitch and the ground, Napier sticks his leg out to deflect it
pushed in quicker and flatter and the batsman is already on the front  foot as he clips it to deep square-leg
slower through the air and shorter, he swivels and pulls to long leg
plays the reverse sweep but ends up placing it straight to short third man
shuffles back and across and clips it to short fine leg
lovely placement! He gets on his knee to a full delivery and sweeps hard with the turn and places it wide of the fielder at long leg
fires it full on the stumps and he digs it back to the bowler
full on the offstump and he pushes it hard to mid-off, takes a sharp single and makes his ground
another yorker and he jams it out to mid-off
squirts it out wide of midwicket and van Wyk makes a desperate attempt to get to the other end and the throw is wide
yorker on the leg stump and he flicks it wide of deep square and picks up an easy couple
excellent inswinging yorker and there was nothing much he could do besides tapping it back to the bowler
fires a yorker and he jams it out to long-on for an easy single
aims for the yorker and strays down the leg side
short and pulled away, he places it between two fielders but not enough power to beat both of them
comes round the wicket and he nudges it to the on side and they think of a single, McCullum scampers back
he drops it shorter this time and he rocks back and cuts to sweeper cover
opens the face again and angles it just wide of short third man
oh well played Morne! He deliberately opens the face and plays a reverse paddle off a full toss and places it wide of short third man
clubs a short delivery and places it to Duminy at midwicket, missed opportunity
paddle it around the corner but fails to place it wide of short fine leg
slower ball and he swishes hard outside off and misses
angles it on the body and he pushes it through the line to long-on
slower ball and he nudges it off his body to the on side
he searches for swing and ends up bowling yet another low full  toss, he squeezes it past short cover
digs out a low full toss and pushes it past the bowler for a single
powers it back to the bowler and Hodge falls over backwards in a desperate attempt to stay behind his crease
full outside off and driven to deep extra cover
angles it on the pads and he clips it to backward square leg
slams it hard but fails to beat cover
tries to paddle it around the corner but misses and Shah lets out a vociferous appeal
crashes a full delivery hard to long-off
bowls the slower one outside of and he opens the face of the bat and steers him to third man
angles it on the pads and he clips it to Jayasuriya again at deep midwicket
gets beside the line and slices it square in the off side
short and he clubs it away down to deep square leg, Jayasuriya has been kept busy
that's a golf swing! Napier overpitches on middle and leg and Hodge takes him downtown with a free swing of the bat and places it high over long-on
lands it full outside off and he mistimes the drive to the covers
chops it hard down to backward point
gets forward and pushes it to mid-off
slams it hard and it's Jayasuriya again at sweeper cover who sprints across and does brilliantly to save two more runs, splendid stuff
rocks back and punches it to deep cover
Dropped Hodge tries to drive straight but ends up slamming it back hard to the bowler who fluffs the catch, he was a little late to react
lands it outside off and he gets width but ends up slapping it to backward point
flighted on middle and leg and defended back to the bowler
glances it to short fine leg
takes a couple of paces down and forces it to midwicket
down the leg side again and he fails to make contact with the sweep
comes over the wicket and strays down the leg side
out of the ground! Can we have the ball back please? Hodge gives him the charge on seeing the flight and carts him dead straight over the sight screen
chips down the track and pushes it wide of midwicket
flighted on the offstump and he plays it with a dead bat
flatter delivery and he works it wide of midwicket
gets down the track and lofts him high over the bowler's head

he clips it to short square leg and there's a lot of hesitation with the running, van Wyk is sent back and the throw is relayed to Harbhajan who leaps up and tries to whip off the bails, the batsman is short of his crease and Harbhajan claims the run out, it goes upstairs and replays show that Harbhajan had dropped the ball and instead broke the stumps with his hand, close call though
chips down the track and he checks his shot and defends
fires the yorker and he digs it out back to the bowler
drops it really short but the ball comes onto him a lot quicker as he shapes to hook, he places it along the turf to fine leg
clips it in front of midwicket and sets off for a quick single
fires it on the offstump and he thumps it to cover
he bowls the slower ball but angles it down the leg side and a faint trickle is enough to beat the diving Pinal Shah
lands it on middle and off and he gets forward and taps it to the off side
fullish outside off and driven through the line to cover
slower through the air and he pushes it with the tunrn to mid-on
comes on straight and bounces a lot more, beats the outside edge as he shapes to cut
steps down the track but the bowler bowls it flatter and forces him to check his shot
gets his front pad across and clips it wide of midwicket
gives him width and he chops it to the off side
angles it across the right hander and gives him a lot of width, he gets his high backlift down and slams it wide of extra cover
teases him with width outside off and he flashes hard and misses
punched hard on the backfoot and he finds backward point
slides it down the leg side and wide called
lands outside off and he defends with soft hands to the off side

the stumps are a mess! Gayle swings hard but fails to pick the slower one from Zaheer, he ends up chopping it onto his stumps and the middle stump lies flattened and the offstump goes for a toss and lands a few yards back
full and swinging in and Gayle helps himself to an easy boundary by whipping it wide of midwicket
keeps it straight and keeps him quiet yet again, Hodge has no room to work with as he taps it down the pitch
keeps it on middle and off and he pats it back down the pitch
half hearted nudge to the on side and Gayle limps to the other end
turns the face of the bat and clips it just wide of midwicket
keeps it on the offstump and he gets beside the line and taps it to backward point
bowls it full and searches for swing and Gayle opens the face and steers it to third man
firm cover drive but Duminy's alert on the off side to cut it off
nice delivery from Zaheer as it lands outside off and comes back in after pitching
poor shot and Ganguly walks back for a golden duck, he reaches out to a wide delivery and plays well away from the body, he gets a thick inside edge and looks back to see his middle stump flattened
just a forward push is enough to squirt it past cover point for a single
gets beside the line and taps it to cover point, Zaheer hits the deck hard
makes him play straightaway and Gayle checks his shot to the on side and ends up placing it back to the bowler
